resources.string: Free up space without deleting anything
Pick photos and videos, set the level — we show the size before and after and a frame comparison. The originals stay until you delete them.
HEIC, JPEG, PNG, H.264, HEVC — for the whole batch at once, keeping the capture date and the location tag.
Pull the audio out of a video
A lecture, an interview, a voice note inside a video — we save it as M4A or WAV without re-encoding anything extra.
A document into a PDF in one shoot
Shoot the pages one after another: the bounds are found on their own, the frame is straightened, everything lands in a single PDF.
